title: Day and Trial Passes: list price, seasonal promotion, price-increase notice, price lock, and group purchase discount
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: the list price of each tier, any seasonal promotional discount, the notice owed before a price increase, any period during which the price is locked, and the discount for purchasing several passes of the same tier at once.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | List price (USD) | Seasonal promo discount | Price-increase notice (days) | Price-lock period (months) | Group purchase discount | Group purchase minimum quantity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 25.00 | 0% | 30 | 0 | 10% | 5 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 45.00 | 5% | 30 | 0 | 0% | 0 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | 79.00 | 5% | 30 | 0 | 0% | 0 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | 99.00 | 5% | 30 | 0 | 0% | 0 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | 149.00 | 5% | 30 | 0 | 0% | 0 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 0.00 | 0% | 0 | 0 | 0% | 0 |

The list price is the amount charged for the tier before any discount is applied. Where a price-increase notice value is set above zero, that many calendar days of advance notice are owed before a price increase on that tier takes effect; a value of zero means no notice period is defined for that tier. Where a price-lock period is set above zero, the tier's price is locked against increases for that many months from purchase; a value of zero means no lock period applies. The Corporate Guest Pass carries no purchase price because it is issued to the visitor at no charge under its employer's sponsorship.

The group purchase discount is the percentage taken off the tier's list price when at least the group purchase minimum quantity of passes of that same tier are purchased together in one transaction; a minimum quantity of zero means the tier defines no group discount. The seasonal promotional discount is a percentage taken off the list price during a promotional period defined for that tier; a value of zero means the tier carries no seasonal promotion.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical)
If a visitor buys 5 Single Day Passes in one transaction, the group purchase minimum quantity of 5 is met and the 10% group discount applies to that purchase. If the same visitor instead buys only 4 Single Day Passes in the transaction, the minimum quantity of 5 is not met and no group discount applies to that purchase.
